stories.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after six decades, becomes chairman emeritus
stories.reason: The 96-year-old investor, who posted a 19.7% compounded annual return since 1965, hands the chairmanship to his son Howard while Greg Abel continues running the company -- closing out one of the defining careers in American business.

stories.title: King Charles warns AI leaders of 'existential dangers' at closed-door summit with Nvidia's Huang and DeepMind's Hassabis
stories.reason: The king told attendees at Dumfries House that 'we need sufficient means of control before it is all too late,' adding a monarch's voice to the same week's industry-wide fight over AI safety pacing.

stories.title: Poland's Tusk warns Russia is planning disguised 'hybrid' drone and rocket strikes on NATO countries
stories.reason: Citing intelligence from NATO, Ukraine and the CIA, Tusk said Moscow intends to stage 'accidental'-looking strikes to test whether Article 5 solidarity holds -- a warning that lands two days after a Russian drone hit a train near the Polish border.

stories.title: Trump administration approves $24.3 billion F-35 fighter jet sale to Saudi Arabia
stories.reason: The 48-jet package would make Saudi Arabia the first Arab nation to field the stealth fighter, timed to an intensifying Houthi campaign against the kingdom, though Congress has 30 days to review or block the deal.

stories.title: OpenAI and Anthropic together earn 10 times more revenue than all Chinese AI models combined
stories.reason: Rhodium Group found the two US labs' combined $105 billion annualized revenue dwarfs the $10.7 billion Chinese models generated, even as DeepSeek and Moonshot trade at far steeper valuation multiples than their American rivals.

stories.title: South Korea's Lee rules out troop deployment for the Iran war, but weighs boosting its naval unit near Hormuz
stories.reason: Lee said Seoul will take only 'minimum activities' to protect its shipping and citizens despite mounting US pressure to help secure the Strait of Hormuz, reflecting growing domestic opposition to any military involvement.

stories.title: Bitcoin tops $80,000 in a relief rally following the Fed and BOJ rate hikes
stories.reason: The 5.5% jump to its strongest level since May came even after the CLARITY Act's Senate defeat, as short sellers who bet on a steeper post-hike drop were forced to buy back in and spot Bitcoin ETFs swung to inflows.

stories.title: A federal judge blocks Trump from tearing down the Kennedy Center without 30 days' notice
stories.reason: The ruling came hours after Trump renewed threats to have the arts center 'ripped down' if his name isn't added to its facade, with a photo submitted in court appearing to show him viewing a 'Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED' placard aboard Air Force One.
